summary: Rare's sci-fi espionage FPS series; use the Xbox 360/Rare Replay remaster for the N64 game, preserve the GBC prequel separately, and mark the canceled reboot honestly.

entries.title: Perfect Dark (Game Boy Color)

emulation.emulator: SameBoy / Gambatte or original Game Boy Color hardware
emulation.notes: Use accurate GBC emulation for preservation; original hardware is needed for full accessory behavior.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Game Boy Color original, accurately emulated

primary.why: The Game Boy Color Perfect Dark is a direct prequel/supplement to the Nintendo 64 game, with built-in rumble, Game Link Cable multiplayer, Game Boy Printer support, and Transfer Pak unlocks for the N64 release. Game Boy Color is the only official platform.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Game Boy Color hardware or an accurate Game Boy Color emulator with owned media; use Transfer Pak with the N64 game only if preserving unlock behavior matters.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster is documented in the cited public source; Transfer Pak-linked unlocks may not survive all digital/emulated contexts.

entries.title: Perfect Dark

emulation.emulator: Xbox backward compatibility; N64 emulator fallback
emulation.notes: Use N64 routes only for original-version comparison.

primary.platform: Xbox 360 / Xbox One / Xbox Series X/S
primary.why: The 2010 remaster runs at 1080p/60fps, adds enhanced graphics, online multiplayer, new controls, and unlocks multiplayer content up front; Rare Replay provides modern Xbox access.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox 360 remaster through Rare Replay/backward compatibility on Xbox One or Series hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: Nintendo Classics preserves the N64 version; the remaster changes renderer/assets and adds online features while preserving the game design.

emulation.notes: Use modern Xbox hardware for enhanced output.

primary.platform: Xbox One X / Xbox Series X/S
primary.why: Perfect Dark Zero is an Xbox 360-only prequel, included in Rare Replay and enhanced on Xbox One with higher resolutions, faster frame rates, and improved textures.
primary.how_to_play: Play through Rare Replay or Xbox backward compatibility on modern Xbox hardware; include multiplayer only where service/player availability permits.

entries.title: Perfect Dark

primary.platform: Cancelled Windows / Xbox Series X/S reboot
primary.why: The Initiative/Crystal Dynamics reboot was canceled in 2025, so no final playable release or best-version comparison exists.
primary.how_to_play: Do not assign a play route; the reboot was canceled before release.

entries.remaster_caveats: Canceled reboot, not a shipped game.
